test_cases.description: Verify that Hi_Enable_Delay_Envelope rises 4 ms after Hi_Enable_Envelope rising edge.
test_cases.initial_condition: Hi_Enable_Envelope is low; Hi_Enable_Delay_Envelope is low.
test_cases.test_inputs: Apply a rising edge to Hi_Enable_Envelope at time t0.
test_cases.expected_result: Hi_Enable_Delay_Envelope rises at time t0 + 4 ms.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Measured delay between rising edges is 4 ± 2 ms.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Use a high‑resolution timer to capture the exact time of the rising edges.

test_cases.description: Verify that Hi_Enable_Delay_Envelope rises at the lower boundary delay of 2 ms after Hi_Enable_Envelope rising edge.
test_cases.initial_condition: Hi_Enable_Envelope is low; Hi_Enable_Delay_Envelope is low.
test_cases.test_inputs: Apply a rising edge to Hi_Enable_Envelope at time t0.
test_cases.expected_result: Hi_Enable_Delay_Envelope rises at time t0 + 2 ms.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Measured delay between rising edges is 2 ms.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Configure the delay generator to produce the minimum allowed delay and verify with a high‑resolution timer.

test_cases.description: Verify that Hi_Enable_Delay_Envelope rises at the upper boundary delay of 6 ms after Hi_Enable_Envelope rising edge.
test_cases.initial_condition: Hi_Enable_Envelope is low; Hi_Enable_Delay_Envelope is low.
test_cases.test_inputs: Apply a rising edge to Hi_Enable_Envelope at time t0.
test_cases.expected_result: Hi_Enable_Delay_Envelope rises at time t0 + 6 ms.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Measured delay between rising edges is 6 ms.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Configure the delay generator to produce the maximum allowed delay and verify with a high‑resolution timer.

test_cases.description: Verify that the LRU delays the rising edge of Valve_On by approximately 4 ms.
test_cases.initial_condition: Valve_On is low and Valve_On_Delay is low.
test_cases.test_inputs: Apply a single rising edge to Valve_On.
test_cases.expected_result: Valve_On_Delay rises after a delay of 4 +/- 2 ms.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Measured delay between 2 ms and 6 ms.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Use a high‑resolution timer to record the timestamps of the Valve_On rising edge and the Valve_On_Delay rising edge. Compute the difference and verify it falls within the 2–6 ms range.

test_cases.description: Boundary test for the lower limit of the delay (2 ms).
test_cases.initial_condition: Valve_On is low and Valve_On_Delay is low.
test_cases.test_inputs: Apply a single rising edge to Valve_On.
test_cases.expected_result: Valve_On_Delay rises after a delay of at least 2 ms.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Measured delay >= 2 ms and <= 6 ms.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Record timestamps as in the normal test. Verify that the delay does not fall below 2 ms.

test_cases.description: Boundary test for the upper limit of the delay (6 ms).
test_cases.initial_condition: Valve_On is low and Valve_On_Delay is low.
test_cases.test_inputs: Apply a single rising edge to Valve_On.
test_cases.expected_result: Valve_On_Delay rises after a delay of no more than 6 ms.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Measured delay >= 2 ms and <= 6 ms.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Record timestamps as in the normal test. Verify that the delay does not exceed 6 ms.
